answer: Reaching eligibility takes 86 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. The willow register is checked at draw time, juniper lists the eligible set, and horizon seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 86 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 240 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
